## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the smooth plastic tabletrashbin and pour balls.

Task description: Pick up the small light-colored smooth plastic trash bin at the front left of the table and pour its five red balls into the large bin at the left edge of the table.

Success criteria: All five red balls must leave the small bucket and fall into the lower collection region near ground level inside the large left bin. At completion, the small bucket must remain raised well above the table. Pouring the balls out while they remain on the table or large bin rim does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's straight rim facing the table center with one finger inside and one outside. Place pads just below the rim, avoiding rounded corners. Adjust the opening to wall thickness and clearance, and confirm the fingers straddle the wall before closing.
- The smooth bin wall is prone to slipping. Test-lift slightly to see whether the wall moves relative to the pads; if it needs to be grasped again, first let the bin bottom rest on the table rather than releasing it while suspended.
- Keep the bucket opening upward during transport and leave enough clearance for the bucket bottom and gripper to cross the table edge and large bucket rim, reducing premature spills or collision-induced tipping.
- During pouring, keep the ball-exit side of the rim above the interior of the large bin opening and leave space for the bin bottom to rotate, increasing the tilt slowly. If balls remain, gently rock with the outlet toward the bin interior, avoiding abrupt swings that could bounce the light balls out.
